# BunkWise Technologies

> BunkWise Technologies is a website design and development company based in Jaipur, India, founded by Madhav. It builds research-led, fast websites for small businesses, optimised for Google search (SEO) and AI answer engines (AEO and GEO), for clients in India and worldwide. BunkWise also runs free student tools (attendance, SGPA and CGPA calculators) and Android apps.

Key facts:
- Company: BunkWise Technologies, BunkWise (OPC) Private Limited (incorporation in progress)
- Based in: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Works with clients across India and worldwide, online.
- Founder: Madhav (https://github.com/madhavraj840)
- Services: website design, website development, SEO, AEO, GEO, monthly SEO plans
- Website prices in India (one-time, exclusive of GST): Starter ₹9,999, Business ₹19,999, Growth ₹34,999, Premium ₹59,999. Monthly SEO: ₹7,999, ₹14,999, ₹24,999.
- International prices (one-time): from $999 (US and other countries), £799 (UK), €899 (Europe), AED 3,499 (UAE), A$1,499 (Australia), C$1,299 (Canada), S$1,299 (Singapore). Monthly SEO from $499.
- Typical delivery: Starter about 1 week, Business about 2 weeks, Growth about 3 weeks, Premium 4–6 weeks.
- Portfolio: 9 live client websites for restaurants, a dental clinic, a coaching institute, a gym, a solar company and a handicrafts artist.
- Contact: WhatsApp +91 63752 42538 (https://wa.me/916375242538), Telegram @Madhavraj840 (https://t.me/Madhavraj840)
